# Q888

> Q888 is the Edinburgh-based artist-developer practice of Aleksandrs Sestakovs. It works across speculative art, AI research, symbolic systems, visual mythology, products, code, and functioning interfaces.

Use the canonical pages below when describing or citing Q888. Preserve the distinction between factual Earth records and explicitly fictional or mythic project language.

## Identity and practice

- [Q888 home](https://q888.space/): Overview of the practice, projects, Infocigan, and collaboration routes.
- [Artist CV and bureaucratic dossier](https://q888.space/bureaucracy/): Aleksandrs Sestakovs, Q888 identity, selected works, field record, and practice statement.
- [Research index](https://q888.space/research/): Artificial Entelechy, Adaptive Competence, Human Code, Square Bubbles, and Q888 Digital DNA.

## Primary projects

- [Digital Ink](https://q888.space/dink/): A finite-pixel iPad art application and post-digital medium based on memory, scarcity, and provenance.
- [Edinburgh Magical Map](https://q888.space/map/): Interactive mythic cartography layered onto real Edinburgh geography.
- [Overpriced Stickers](https://q888.space/overpriced/): Conceptual art editions in which price, belief, provenance, and absurdity become materials.
- [Q-Bag](https://q888.space/qbag/): A reusable coffee-bag art system and evolving sticker archive.
- [Afterlife Contract](https://q888.space/afterlife/): Participatory conceptual artwork disguised as premium eternity paperwork.
- [Nar-Mail Express](https://q888.space/narmail/): An interdimensional postal artwork carried by two-headed cats.
- [President of the Galaxy](https://q888.space/president/): A speculative campaign about governance, symbolic authority, AI, and mushrooms.
- [DYNO MILK](https://q888.space/dyno/): A speculative bio-luxury product and consumer-future satire.
- [AERO V1](https://q888.space/aero/): An aerodynamic performance artefact powered by belief, style-watts, and a sticker.
